Podcast host Chris Williamson joins Joe Rogan for episode 2544. Williamson runs Modern Wisdom, a show built on long talks about life and the mind. His style is calm, curious, and well read.

Rogan and Williamson trade views on self-growth, habits, and modern stress. Both hosts know the long-form game from the inside. The talk moves at an easy pace, with room for doubt. Listeners who track either show get a crossover that feels natural: two interviewers, for once, answering as much as they ask. The respect between them shows throughout the talk.
podcast-tuckercarlson-ZG28ZnNQh6I:
Tucker Carlson hosts Robert F. Kennedy Jr. and radio host Larry Elder after a second attempt on Donald Trump's life. All three speak before a live crowd. The mood in the room mixes shock, anger, and resolve.

Kennedy talks about his love for the country and his roots on both coasts. The group reacts to the shooting and to the state of the campaign. They blame harsh rhetoric and weak guard work for the danger. The episode preserves a raw public moment when fear and politics met on one stage.
